All agents in the team, including the agents that you can assign tasks to, are equally intelligent and capable, and have access to the same set of tools.\n\nYou can use `spawn_agent` to create a new agent, `followup_task` to give an existing agent a new task and trigger a turn, and `send_message` to pass a message to a running agent.\n`send_message` calls may be read by a human, so ensure they are legible.         "text": "# AGENTS.md instructions for D:\\HCUP\\vg-spec7\n\n<INSTRUCTIONS>\n# HarmonyOS NEXT 开发核心规则与最佳实践\r\n\r\n本文档基于 Huawei 开发者官方文档及社区最佳实践整理，适用于 HarmonyOS NEXT (API 12+) 开发。\r\n\r\n## 1. ArkTS 语言规范 (强制)\r\n\r\nArkTS 是 HarmonyOS NEXT 的主力开发语言，基于 TypeScript 扩展，但在运行时有更严格的限制以提升性能。\r\n\r\n### 1.1 严格类型安全\r\n- **禁止使用 `any` 和 `unknown`**：必须显式声明变量和函数返回值的类型。\r\n- **禁止运行时动态特性**：不支持动态添加属性、删除属性等 JS 动态操作。\r\n- **空安全**：启用严格空检查 (`strictNullChecks`)，并在代码中显式处理 `null` 和 `undefined`。\r\n- **ESObject**：仅在与 JS 库交互或跨语言调用时使用 `ESObject`，并在使用完毕后尽快转换为具体的 ArkTS 类型。\r\n\r\n### 1.2 语法限制\r\n- **类定义**：必须在声明时初始化字段，或在构造函数中初始化。\r\n- **模块化**：使用 ES6 模块标准 (`import`/`export`)，禁止使用 CommonJS (`require`).\r\n- **并发模型**：ArkTS 采用 Actor 模型，内存隔离。线程间通信需通过 `TaskPool` 或 `Worker`，数据传递通常是深拷贝或 Transferable 对象。\r\n\r\n## 2. ArkUI 开发规范\r\n\r\n### 2.1 组件化设计\r\n- **`@Component`**：UI 组件必须使用 `@Component` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Entry`**：页面入口组件使用 `@Entry` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Builder` / `@BuilderParam`**：轻量级 UI 复用，优先于自定义组件，减少组件实例开销。\r\n- **组件拆分**：将复杂页面拆分为多个子组件，保持代码清晰，每个组件文件不超过 500 行。\r\n\r\n### 2.2 状态管理\r\n- **原则**：最小化状态共享范围，避免全局状态滥用。\r\n- **装饰器选择**：\r\n  - `@State`：组件内部私有状态。\r\n  - `@Prop`：父子单向同步（父 -> 子）。\r\n  - `@Link`：父子双向同步（父 <-> 子）。\r\n  - `@Provide`/`@Consume`：跨组件层级同步。\r\n  - `AppStorage`/`LocalStorage`：全局或页面级状态共享。\r\n- **更新机制**：状态变量必须通过赋值更新，不要直接修改对象属性（除非使用 `@Observed` 和 `@ObjectLink` 处理嵌套对象）。\r\n\r\n### 2.3 布局与样式\r\n- **单位**：统一使用 `vp` (虚拟像素) 和 `fp` (字体像素)，禁止硬编码 `px`。\r\n- **布局性能**：\r\n  - 减少布局嵌套层级（特别是 `Stack` 和 `Flex` 的深层嵌套）。\r\n  - 优先使用 `RelativeContainer` 替代复杂的嵌套布局。\r\n  - 列表渲染必须使用 `LazyForEach`，并提供唯一的 `keyGenerator`，避免全量重绘。\r\n- **自适应**：使用断点 (`GridRow`/`GridCol`) 和媒体查询适配多设备屏幕。\r\n\r\n## 3. 性能优化指南\r\n\r\n### 3.1 渲染性能\r\n- **LazyForEach**：长列表数据必须使用 `LazyForEach` 加载，配合 `cachedCount` 预加载。\r\n- **条件渲染**：频繁切换显隐建议使用 `visibility` 属性控制，而非 `if/else`（后者会触发生命周期）。\r\n- **图片优化**：加载大图时使用 `Image` 组件的 `sourceSize` 属性进行解码尺寸裁剪，避免内存浪费。\r\n\r\n### 3.2 并发与异步\r\n- **主线程减负**：耗时操作（IO、复杂计算、网络请求）必须移至后台线程。\r\n- **TaskPool**：优先使用 `TaskPool` 处理短时任务，系统会自动管理线程生命周期。\r\n- **Worker**：适用于长时间运行的后台任务。\r\n- **Promise**：异步操作统一使用 Promise 或 async/await，避免回调地狱。\r\n\r\n### 3.3 内存管理\r\n- **资源释放**：组件销毁时 (`aboutToDisappear`) 及时注销事件监听、定时器和后台任务。\r\n- **上下文泄漏**：避免在长生命周期对象中持有 AbilityContext 或 UI 组件引用。\r\n\r\n## 4. 项目架构与工程规范\r\n\r\n### 4.1 目录结构\r\n```text\r\nentry/src/main/ets/\r\n├── pages/          # 页面入口 (@Entry)\r\n├── components/     # 公共 UI 组件\r\n├── model/          # 数据模型 (Class/Interface)\r\n├── utils/          # 工具类\r\n├── service/        # 业务逻辑服务 (API, Database)\r\n├── common/         # 全局常量、枚举\r\n└── resources/      # 静态资源\r\n```\r\n\r\n### 4.2 命名规范\r\n- **类/接口/组件**：PascalCase (e.g., `UserComponent`, `DataService`)\r\n- **变量/函数/方法**：camelCase (e.g., `fetchUserData`, `isOpen`)\r\n- **常量/枚举值**：UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g., `MAX_RETRY_COUNT`)\r\n- **文件命名**：与主要导出内容一致，组件文件通常 PascalCase，工具文件 camelCase。\r\n\r\n### 4.3 Kit 使用\r\n- 优先使用 HarmonyOS 内置 Kit (如 `ArkData` 用于数据库, `NetworkKit` 用于网络, `ArkUI` 用于界面)。\r\n- 引入第三方库前需确认其是否支持 HarmonyOS NEXT (ArkTS 兼容性)。\r\n\r\n## 5. 安全与隐私\r\n\r\n- **权限最小化**：仅申请业务必须的权限 (`module.json5`)。\r\n- **用户授权**：运行时敏感权限必须向用户动态申请。\r\n- **数据安全**：\r\n  - 敏感数据（Token、密码）存储使用 `WebDavCrypto` 或系统级 `KeyStore`。\r\n  - 本地数据库优先使用 `RdbStore` 或 `Preferences` 并加密。\r\n\r\n---\r\n\r\n# 本题自动调度\r\n\r\n题号：vg-spec7\r\n\r\n本题根目录：D:/HCUP/vg-spec7\r\n\r\n主 Agent 开始/继续作答时加载 `D:/HarmonyDev/codex/skills/harmony-task-flow/SKILL.md`，读取 workflow/state.json，调度四个角色并按失败证据回退。\r\n\r\n子 Agent 仅完成收到的派工，不自行成为调度者或创建子 Agent。仅使用本题 inputs、project 和记录；禁止其他题工程及相关上游修复历史。\r\n\r\n## HCUP 工作区布局与阶段\r\n\r\n本题工程根就是当前目录；workflow/state.json 的 project 指向当前目录，不要再创建 project 子目录，也不要使用 Skill 示例中的另一套工程路径。\r\n\r\n本题需求读取 spec/requirement.md，元数据读取 spec/metadata.json；inputs/ 保留原始输入副本。公共资源只读访问 ../common/，不得访问其他赛题目录。\r\n\r\n开始构建或设备命令前加载 D:/HCUP/.hcup-local/Enter-HarmonyEnv.ps1。\r\n\r\n本次仅完成独立工程准备；尚未分析需求、设计方案或实现功能。正式作答从本目录的新会话开始，登记新会话后再按四角色流程推进。\r\n\r\n初始化总览会话也包含公共环境、官方示例与其他题的工程准备内容，不能将其视为本题功能开发证据；后续需求和编码角色不要读取该总览会话作为实现参考。\r\n\n</INSTRUCTIONS>"

      "aggregated_output": "# HarmonyOS NEXT 开发核心规则与最佳实践\r\n\r\n本文档基于 Huawei 开发者官方文档及社区最佳实践整理，适用于 HarmonyOS NEXT (API 12+) 开发。\r\n\r\n## 1. ArkTS 语言规范 (强制)\r\n\r\nArkTS 是 HarmonyOS NEXT 的主力开发语言，基于 TypeScript 扩展，但在运行时有更严格的限制以提升性能。\r\n\r\n### 1.1 严格类型安全\r\n- **禁止使用 `any` 和 `unknown`**：必须显式声明变量和函数返回值的类型。\r\n- **禁止运行时动态特性**：不支持动态添加属性、删除属性等 JS 动态操作。\r\n- **空安全**：启用严格空检查 (`strictNullChecks`)，并在代码中显式处理 `null` 和 `undefined`。\r\n- **ESObject**：仅在与 JS 库交互或跨语言调用时使用 `ESObject`，并在使用完毕后尽快转换为具体的 ArkTS 类型。\r\n\r\n### 1.2 语法限制\r\n- **类定义**：必须在声明时初始化字段，或在构造函数中初始化。\r\n- **模块化**：使用 ES6 模块标准 (`import`/`export`)，禁止使用 CommonJS (`require`).\r\n- **并发模型**：ArkTS 采用 Actor 模型，内存隔离。线程间通信需通过 `TaskPool` 或 `Worker`，数据传递通常是深拷贝或 Transferable 对象。\r\n\r\n## 2. ArkUI 开发规范\r\n\r\n### 2.1 组件化设计\r\n- **`@Component`**：UI 组件必须使用 `@Component` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Entry`**：页面入口组件使用 `@Entry` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Builder` / `@BuilderParam`**：轻量级 UI 复用，优先于自定义组件，减少组件实例开销。\r\n- **组件拆分**：将复杂页面拆分为多个子组件，保持代码清晰，每个组件文件不超过 500 行。\r\n\r\n### 2.2 状态管理\r\n- **原则**：最小化状态共享范围，避免全局状态滥用。\r\n- **装饰器选择**：\r\n  - `@State`：组件内部私有状态。\r\n  - `@Prop`：父子单向同步（父 -> 子）。\r\n  - `@Link`：父子双向同步（父 <-> 子）。\r\n  - `@Provide`/`@Consume`：跨组件层级同步。\r\n  - `AppStorage`/`LocalStorage`：全局或页面级状态共享。\r\n- **更新机制**：状态变量必须通过赋值更新，不要直接修改对象属性（除非使用 `@Observed` 和 `@ObjectLink` 处理嵌套对象）。\r\n\r\n### 2.3 布局与样式\r\n- **单位**：统一使用 `vp` (虚拟像素) 和 `fp` (字体像素)，禁止硬编码 `px`。\r\n- **布局性能**：\r\n  - 减少布局嵌套层级（特别是 `Stack` 和 `Flex` 的深层嵌套）。\r\n  - 优先使用 `RelativeContainer` 替代复杂的嵌套布局。\r\n  - 列表渲染必须使用 `LazyForEach`，并提供唯一的 `keyGenerator`，避免全量重绘。\r\n- **自适应**：使用断点 (`GridRow`/`GridCol`) 和媒体查询适配多设备屏幕。\r\n\r\n## 3. 性能优化指南\r\n\r\n### 3.1 渲染性能\r\n- **LazyForEach**：长列表数据必须使用 `LazyForEach` 加载，配合 `cachedCount` 预加载。\r\n- **条件渲染**：频繁切换显隐建议使用 `visibility` 属性控制，而非 `if/else`（后者会触发生命周期）。\r\n- **图片优化**：加载大图时使用 `Image` 组件的 `sourceSize` 属性进行解码尺寸裁剪，避免内存浪费。\r\n\r\n### 3.2 并发与异步\r\n- **主线程减负**：耗时操作（IO、复杂计算、网络请求）必须移至后台线程。\r\n- **TaskPool**：优先使用 `TaskPool` 处理短时任务，系统会自动管理线程生命周期。\r\n- **Worker**：适用于长时间运行的后台任务。\r\n- **Promise**：异步操作统一使用 Promise 或 async/await，避免回调地狱。\r\n\r\n### 3.3 内存管理\r\n- **资源释放**：组件销毁时 (`aboutToDisappear`) 及时注销事件监听、定时器和后台任务。\r\n- **上下文泄漏**：避免在长生命周期对象中持有 AbilityContext 或 UI 组件引用。\r\n\r\n## 4. 项目架构与工程规范\r\n\r\n### 4.1 目录结构\r\n```text\r\nentry/src/main/ets/\r\n├── pages/          # 页面入口 (@Entry)\r\n├── components/     # 公共 UI 组件\r\n├── model/          # 数据模型 (Class/Interface)\r\n├── utils/          # 工具类\r\n├── service/        # 业务逻辑服务 (API, Database)\r\n├── common/         # 全局常量、枚举\r\n└── resources/      # 静态资源\r\n```\r\n\r\n### 4.2 命名规范\r\n- **类/接口/组件**：PascalCase (e.g., `UserComponent`, `DataService`)\r\n- **变量/函数/方法**：camelCase (e.g., `fetchUserData`, `isOpen`)\r\n- **常量/枚举值**：UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g., `MAX_RETRY_COUNT`)\r\n- **文件命名**：与主要导出内容一致，组件文件通常 PascalCase，工具文件 camelCase。\r\n\r\n### 4.3 Kit 使用\r\n- 优先使用 HarmonyOS 内置 Kit (如 `ArkData` 用于数据库, `NetworkKit` 用于网络, `ArkUI` 用于界面)。\r\n- 引入第三方库前需确认其是否支持 HarmonyOS NEXT (ArkTS 兼容性)。\r\n\r\n## 5. 安全与隐私\r\n\r\n- **权限最小化**：仅申请业务必须的权限 (`module.json5`)。\r\n- **用户授权**：运行时敏感权限必须向用户动态申请。\r\n- **数据安全**：\r\n  - 敏感数据（Token、密码）存储使用 `WebDavCrypto` 或系统级 `KeyStore`。\r\n  - 本地数据库优先使用 `RdbStore` 或 `Preferences` 并加密。\r\n\r\n---\r\n\r\n# 本题自动调度\r\n\r\n题号：vg-spec7\r\n\r\n本题根目录：D:/HCUP/vg-spec7\r\n\r\n主 Agent       "aggregated_output": "docs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/Concurrency/async-concurrency-overview.md:1:# Asynchronous Concurrency (Promise and Async/Await)\r\ndocs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/Concurrency/async-concurrency-overview.md:10:Promise and async/await are standard JavaScript asynchronous syntax, which provides the asynchronous concurrency capability. Asynchronous code is suspended and continues to execute later, ensuring that only one piece of code is executed at any given moment. The following are typical scenarios of asynchronous concurrency:\r\ndocs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/Concurrency/async-concurrency-overview.md:18:Asynchronous concurrency is a feature of programming languages that allows programs to continue executing other asynchronous code without waiting for certain operations to complete.\r\ndocs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/Concurrency/async-concurrency-overview.md:20:## Promise\r\ndocs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/Concurrency/async-concurrency-overview.md:22:A Promise is an object used to process asynchronous operations. It converts asynchronous operations into a style similar to synchronous operations for easier code writing and maintenance. A Promise manages different phases of asynchronous operations through the state mechanism. There are three states for a Promise: pending (in progress), fulfilled (completed, also called resolved), and rejected (failed). After creation, a Promise is in the pending state and transitions to the fulfilled or rejected state upon completion of the asynchronous operation.\r\ndocs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/Concurrency/async-concurrency-overview.md:24:Promise provides the **then**, **catch**, and **finally** methods to register callback functions to handle the success or failure of asynchronous operations. When the Promise status changes, the callback function is added to the microtask queue for execution. The event loop mechanism ensures that microtasks are executed first after macro tasks are executed, thereby ensuring asynchronous scheduling of callback functions.\r\ndocs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/Concurrency/async-concurrency-overview.md:26:The most basic usage involves instantiating a Promise object through its constructor, passing in a function (usually named **executor**) with two parameters. The two parameters are **resolve** and **reject**, which represent the callback functions for the success and failure of the asynchronous operation, respectively.\r\ndocs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/Concurrency/async-concurrency-overview.md:27:For example, the code snippet below creates a Promise object and simulates an asynchronous operation:\r\ndocs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/Concurrency/async-concurrency-overview.md:30:const promise: Promise<number> = new Promise((resolve: Function, reject: Function) => {\r\ndocs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/Concurrency/async-concurrency-overview.md:41:<!-- @[promise_async_operation](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/applications_app_samples/blob/master/code/DocsSample/ArkTS/ArkTsConcurrent/AsyncConcurrencyOverview/entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets) -->\r\ndocs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/Concurrency/async-concurrency-overview.md:43:In the above code, the **setTimeout** function simulates an asynchronous operation and generates a random number after 1 second. If the random number is greater than 0.5, the **resolve** callback is invoked with the random number; otherwise, the **reject** callback is invoked with an error object.\r\ndocs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/Concurrency/async-concurrency-overview.md:45:After a Promise object is created, you can use the **then** and **catch** methods to specify callback functions for the fulfilled and rejected states. The **then** method can accept two parameters: one for handling the fulfilled state and the other for handling the rejected state. If only one parameter is passed in, the **then** method automatically calls the callback function when the Promise object state changes to **fulfilled**, with the result of the Promise object passed as a parameter. The **catch** method receives a callback function to handle failures, that is, capturing the Promise's transition to the rejected state or any exceptions thrown during the operation. The **finally** method receives a callback function, which will be executed regardless of the Promise's final state (fulfilled or rejected). A Promise manages different phases of asynchronous operations through the state mechanism. There are three states for a Promise: pending (in progress), fulfilled (completed, also called resolved), and rejected (failed).       "status": "completed",
      "aggregated_output": "1:# Asynchronous Concurrency (Promise and Async/Await)\r\n2:<!--Kit: ArkTS-->\r\n3:<!--Subsystem: CommonLibrary-->\r\n4:<!--Owner: @wang_zhaoyong-->\r\n5:<!--Designer: @weng-changcheng-->\r\n6:<!--Tester: @kirl75; @zsw_zhushiwei-->\r\n7:<!--Adviser: @ge-yafang-->\r\n8:\r\n9:\r\n10:Promise and async/await are standard JavaScript asynchronous syntax, which provides the asynchronous concurrency capability. Asynchronous code is suspended and continues to execute later, ensuring that only one piece of code is executed at any given moment. The following are typical scenarios of asynchronous concurrency:\r\n11:\r\n12:- Non-blocking I/O operations: network requests, file reading and writing, and timers.\r\n13:\r\n14:- Lightweight tasks without CPU blocking: tasks with short execution times.\r\n15:\r\n16:- Clear logical dependencies: tasks with explicit order or parallel relationships.\r\n17:\r\n18:Asynchronous concurrency is a feature of programming languages that allows programs to continue executing other asynchronous code without waiting for certain operations to complete.\r\n19:\r\n20:## Promise\r\n21:\r\n22:A Promise is an object used to process asynchronous operations. It converts asynchronous operations into a style similar to synchronous operations for easier code writing and maintenance. A Promise manages different phases of asynchronous operations through the state mechanism. There are three states for a Promise: pending (in progress), fulfilled (completed, also called resolved), and rejected (failed). After creation, a Promise is in the pending state and transitions to the fulfilled or rejected state upon completion of the asynchronous operation.\r\n23:\r\n24:Promise provides the **then**, **catch**, and **finally** methods to register callback functions to handle the success or failure of asynchronous operations. When the Promise status changes, the callback function is added to the microtask queue for execution. The event loop mechanism ensures that microtasks are executed first after macro tasks are executed, thereby ensuring asynchronous scheduling of callback functions.\r\n25:\r\n26:The most basic usage involves instantiating a Promise object through its constructor, passing in a function (usually named **executor**) with two parameters. The two parameters are **resolve** and **reject**, which represent the callback functions for the success and failure of the asynchronous operation, respectively.\r\n87:## Async/Await\r\n88:\r\n89:Async/Await is syntactic sugar for handling asynchronous operations with Promises, making it easier and more readable to write asynchronous code. You can use the **async** keyword to declare an asynchronous function and the **await** keyword to wait for the resolution (fulfilled or rejected) of a Promise, and write asynchronous operation code in synchronous mode.\r\n90:\r\n91:An **async** function returns a Promise object to implement an asynchronous operation. It can contain zero or more **await** keywords, pausing execution until the associated Promise completes its state transition (fulfilled/rejected). If an exception is thrown during function execution, the exception directly triggers the returned Promise to enter the rejected state, and the error object can be captured using the **catch** method or the second callback parameter of **then**.\r\n92:\r\n129:In the preceding example code, **await** waits for the Promise to resolve and stores the resolved value in the **result** variable.\r\n130:\r\n131:Since you need to wait for the completion of the asynchronous operation, the entire operation must be wrapped in an **async** function and used with the **await** keyword. The **await** keyword is valid only in **async** functions. You can also use **try**/**catch** blocks to catch exceptions.\r\n93:    console.info('Read config');\r\n94:  } finally {\r\n95:    console.info('Close resource');\r\n96:  }\r\n97:}\r\n98:```\r\n99:\r\n100:Typical `finally` work includes:\r\n101:\r\n102:- releasing resources\r\n103:- resetting temporary state\r\n104:- stopping timers\r\n105:- writing final diagnostics\r\n106:\r\n107:`finally` is about cleanup, not normal result handling.\r\n108:\r\n109:Do not use `return`, `throw`, `break`, or `continue` inside `finally`. Those statements can hide the original control flow or replace an exception that should keep propagating.\r\n110:\r\n111:## Custom Error Types\r\n112:\r\n113:Create a class derived from `Error` when the program benefits from a more specific failure category:\r\n114:\r\n115:```typescript\r\n116:class ValidationError extends Error {\r\n117:  constructor(message: string) {\r\n118:    super(message);\r\n119:  }\r\n120:}\r\n121:```\r\n122:\r\n",

Asynchronous code is suspended and continues to execute later, ensuring that only one piece of code is executed at any given moment. The following are typical scenarios of asynchronous concurrency:\\r\\n11:\\r\\n12:- Non-blocking I/O operations: network requests, file reading and writing, and timers.\\r\\n13:\\r\\n14:- Lightweight tasks without CPU blocking: tasks with short execution times.\\r\\n15:\\r\\n16:- Clear logical dependencies: tasks with explicit order or parallel relationships.\\r\\n17:\\r\\n18:Asynchronous concurrency is a feature of programming languages that allows programs to continue executing other asynchronous code without waiting for certain operations to complete.\\r\\n19:\\r\\n20:## Promise\\r\\n21:\\r\\n22:A Promise is an object used to process asynchronous operations. It converts asynchronous operations into a style similar to synchronous operations for easier code writing and maintenance. A Promise manages different phases of asynchronous operations through the state mechanism. There are three states for a Promise: pending (in progress), fulfilled (completed, also called resolved), and rejected (failed). After creation, a Promise is in the pending state and transitions to the fulfilled or rejected state upon completion of the asynchronous operation.\\r\\n23:\\r\\n24:Promise provides the **then**, **catch**, and **finally** methods to register callback functions to handle the success or failure of asynchronous operations. When the Promise status changes, the callback function is added to the microtask queue for execution. The event loop mechanism ensures that microtasks are executed first after macro tasks are executed, thereby ensuring asynchronous scheduling of callback functions.\\r\\n25:\\r\\n26:The most basic usage involves instantiating a Promise object through its constructor, passing in a function (usually named **executor**) with two parameters. The two parameters are **resolve** and **reject**, which represent the callback functions for the success and failure of the asynchronous operation, respectively.\\r\\n87:## Async/Await\\r\\n88:\\r\\n89:Async/Await is syntactic sugar for handling asynchronous operations with Promises, making it easier and more readable to write asynchronous code. You can use the **async** keyword to declare an asynchronous function and the **await** keyword to wait for the resolution (fulfilled or rejected) of a Promise, and write asynchronous operation code in synchronous mode.\\r\\n90:\\r\\n91:An **async** function returns a Promise object to implement an asynchronous operation. It can contain zero or more **await** keywords, pausing execution until the associated Promise completes its state transition (fulfilled/rejected). If an exception is thrown during function execution, the exception directly triggers the returned Promise to enter the rejected state, and the error object can be captured using the **catch** method or the second callback parameter of **then**.\\r\\n92:\\r\\n129:In the preceding example code, **await** waits for the Promise to resolve and stores the resolved value in the **result** variable.\\r\\n130:\\r\\n131:Since you need to wait for the completion of the asynchronous operation, the entire operation must be wrapped in an **async** function and used with the **await** keyword. The **await** keyword is valid only in **async** functions. You can also use **try**/**catch** blocks to catch exceptions.\\r\\n93:    console.info('Read config');\\r\\n94:  } finally {\\r\\n95:    console.info('Close resource');\\r\\n96:  }\\r\\n97:}\\r\\n98:```\\r\\n99:\\r\\n100:Typical `finally` work includes:\\r\\n101:\\r\\n102:- releasing resources\\r\\n103:- resetting temporary state\\r\\n104:- stopping timers\\r\\n105:- writing final diagnostics\\r\\n106:\\r\\n107:`finally` is about cleanup, not normal result handling.\\r\\n108:\\r\\n109:Do not use `return`, `throw`, `break`, or `continue` inside `finally`. Those statements can hide the original control flow or replace an exception that should keep propagating.\\r\\n110:\\r\\n111:## Custom Error Types\\r\\n112:\\r\\n113:Create a class derived from `Error` when the program benefits from a more specific failure category:\\r\\n114:\\r\\n115:```typescript\\r\\n116:class ValidationError extends Error {\\r\\n117:  constructor(message: string) {\\r\\n118:    super(message);\\r\\n119:  }\\r\\n120:}\\r\\n121:```\\r\\n122:\\r\\n\"}}"

更新内存配置，`:114` 清布局缓存，`:120` 保存 JSON。此方法本身没有网络请求；store 未就绪时 `:121` 仍可返回 true，不能仅凭成功提示证明已落盘。\n- `utils/WebDavStateStore.ets:63` 使用 Preferences `webdav_state_store`；设置、manifest、snapshot keys 在 `:66`、`:72`、`:78`；`:284` 至 `:299` 保存主值、备份值、时间戳并 flush；`:261` 至 `:281` 可从备份修复主值。\n- **重要代码事实**：恢复入口 `SettingsSyncSection.ets:164` 不调用保存，使用管理器已有配置。字段修改只更新 `@Link`。离页 `SettingsPage.ets:159` 调用的 `saveSettings`（`:300`）保存的是普通 `AppSettings` 和 API key，不保存 WebDAV 字段。故“输入配置后是否需要先点保存”应在验收前置中明确，不能假定恢复自动使用未保存输入。\n- `sync/webdav/WebDavCommon.ets:102` 的 manifest 记录备份时间/ETag、事件及增量同步状态；`:207` 的 `WebDavBackupPlainResult` 持有结果与解密明文。\n\nloading 与弹窗联动：\n\n- `webdavBusy` 在任何下载或确认之前即为 true；五个操作按钮分别在 `SettingsSyncSection.ets:446`、`:456`、`:481`、`:497`、`:507` 全部改为“处理中...”并禁用。确认框出现时仍忙。\n- 管理器下载状态则在 `sync/WebDavSyncManager.ets:493` 下载结束后恢复为 `IDLE` 或 `ERROR`；因此等待确认期间，页面 busy 与管理器状态不是同一个状态。\n- `SettingsSyncSection.ets:113` 至 `:121` 用 `Promise.race` 包装超时；代码没有清除定时器或取消底层工作。**静态推断、未实测**：停留确认框超过 120 秒可能先走超时和 finally 清忙，而原异步流程仍存活，后来确认仍可能继续导入。\n- 子组件没有与恢复操作配套的 `aboutToDisappear` 清理。离开区段后的未完成操作表现未验证。\n\n自动同步干扰：\n\n- `entryability/EntryAbility.ets:49` 至 `:54` 每次前台初始化后调用 `tryRun('foreground')`。\n- `sync/AutoWebDavSyncManager.ets:33` 使用独立 `busy`；`:44` 检查已配置地址/账号，`:48` 检查开关，`:53` 至 `:58` 检查间隔，`:65` 调用 `syncIncremental`，`:75` 可选全量备份。\n- 默认开关为开：`utils/WebDavStateStore.ets:170` 至 `:173`；默认间隔 6 小时在 `:184`。页面开关在 `SettingsSyncSection.ets:380` 至 `:383` 只保存开关，没有直接调用同步。\n- 自动同步不仅发请求，也能导入增量数据：`sync/WebDavSyncManager.ets:705` 执行下载任务，`:716` 调用 `importIncremental`；下载任务的网络入口是 `sync/webdav/WebDavSyncTask.ets:131`。\n- **静态推断**：恢复页面的 `webdavBusy` 不会阻止独立自动同步，且管理器恢复函数没有统一互斥检查。前台切换或已在途同步可能污染“确认前零请求”和数据不变断言。验证时需关闭自动同步、等待已有任务结束，再划定服务端观测窗口；不能把后台请求直接归因于点击恢复。\n\n可复用既有模式与缺失项：\n\n- 本地导入确认模式在 `pages/settings/SettingsBackupSection.ets:152`：预览 `:153`，原生确认 `:164`，取消 `:174`，确认后导入 `:180`，catch 取消 `:189`。父页粘贴导入还有 `pages/SettingsPage.ets:355` 至 `:375` 的相同模式。\n- `pages/settings/SettingsSyncDialog.ets:8` 是本地粘贴/导出弹层，通过 `visible` 等 `@Link` 控制（`:9` 至 `:13`），遮罩关闭在 `:44`，导入回调在 `:113`，取消在 `:125`。它不是 WebDAV 恢复确认框。\n- 相对 Spec 缺失：请求前先出现的恢复确认阶段；“继续”操作入口；取消/未继续期间零恢复请求的控制边界。现有恢复、下载解密、预览、数据导入能力已经存在。\n- 本次分析不提出实施文件修改或接口变更。\n\n目标流程选择器风险：\n\n| 对象 | 基线 id / 风险 |\n|---|---|\n| 首页、设置页根 | `pages/Index.ets:360` 为 `index_ +
